name: PA-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: District leans Democratic by about 8 points on the partisan baseline
Dean holds a massive fundraising advantage ($1.2M cash vs. under $5K)
Prediction markets price Dean near 97% to win
Challenger is minimally funded and unknown
model.rationale: Madeleine Dean is a well-funded incumbent in a district that leans Democratic, while Aurora Stuski has raised almost nothing, and markets price the race as a near-certain Democratic hold. The fundamentals point to a comfortable double-digit margin.
model.watch: A major outside-spending surge for the challenger or a sharp national Republican wave environment could narrow the margin, though not plausibly enough to threaten the seat.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Madeleine Dean seeks another term in a suburban Philadelphia district that voted Democratic by about eight points at the presidential level. She enters the general election with a large financial edge, holding more than $1.1 million after raising $1.4 million, while Republican Aurora Stuski has raised under $9,000 and has no meaningful outside support on either side.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets give Dean roughly a 97 percent chance of winning. With the incumbent advantage, the district lean, and the funding gap all pointing the same direction, this seat is rated Safe Democratic, with an expected margin near twenty points.
